description: hand-authored structured rubric (behavioral anchors + solve-first), blind to eval diagnosis

edits.label: Yes
edits.text: The reply supplies correct and relevant help the student can use — a hint, elaboration, example, explanation, or a supporting question that targets the actual difficulty.

edits.label: To some extent
edits.text: The reply attempts relevant help but it is partial, vague, or only loosely tied to the student's error, leaving the next step under-specified.

edits.label: No
edits.text: The reply offers no real guidance — it merely acknowledges, praises, repeats the task, states the answer outright, or is off the point.
Before choosing a label, reason out what the ideal next tutoring move would be, then score the reply on whether it delivers that help, not on tone or verbosity.
